public_question: Molecular serialization fidelity under two representation standards. Three supplied graphs retain all fragments, their tautomer representation and stereo. The experimental conditions are a SELFIES round trip and a standard-InChI round trip. For each k=a,b,c report selfies_k, its SELFIES symbol count token_count_k, decoded_k, inchi_k and recovered_inchi_k. canonical_k,canonical_selfies_k,canonical_inchi_k are canonical isomeric SMILES of the original and the two recovered graphs under keep_all/preserve/keep_stereo=true. self_same_k and inchi_same_k are exact canonical-identity comparisons with the original. masses_k is the [original,SELFIES-recovered,InChI-recovered] average-molar-mass vector in g/mol. Changed recovered representations remain part of the report; graph fidelity and mass agreement are separate questions. Return the named fields in the supplied JSON answer contract. Unless a field states otherwise,numeric tolerance is absolute1e-6 plus relative1e-6; selection ties use absolute1e-9. Array order follows the input order unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Element-constrained blend optimization and inventory audit. Three graph-defined stocks a,b,c are theoretical elemental inventory controls. Their reported formula_k, average mass_k(g/mol), and formula-based CNO_k mass fractions in[C,N,O] describe different declared readouts. A blend totals100g, each stock contributes between0and70g, oxygen mass is at least15g and nitrogen mass at most12g. The objective is maximum carbon mass under these constraints. allocation_g is a feasible optimum in[a,b,c]order; carbon_g,nitrogen_g,oxygen_g,total_g describe that allocation. An independent elemental matrix-balance witness for the reported allocation is required. This is a continuous inventory model, not a reaction, yield prediction or preparation instruction. Return the named fields in the supplied JSON answer contract. Unless a field states otherwise,numeric tolerance is absolute1e-6 plus relative1e-6; selection ties use absolute1e-9. Array order follows the input order unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Weighted-tree distances and trait geometries. Three weighted tree hypotheses share fixed taxa[A,B,C,D]: a, a uniformly rescaled version b, and topology-altered c. Report patristic_a,b,c and total_length_a,b,c. Compute raw_trait_distances (Euclidean) and standardized_trait_distances after population scaling across the same four taxa. For EACH tree and EACH trait geometry report Pearson upper-triangle correlation raw_corr_a etc. and scaled_corr_a etc. with zero permutations. Report length_ratio_b_a and distance_b_over_a for pair[A,B]. Correlation invariance must not be taken as equality of branch units, topology or evolutionary rates. Return the named answer fields as JSON. Numeric values must agree within absolute 1e-6 plus relative 1e-6; winner ties use absolute 1e-9. Array order follows the supplied data order unless explicitly stated otherwise. Required output fields: raw_trait_distances, standardized_trait_distances, patristic_a, total_length_a, raw_corr_a, scaled_corr_a, patristic_b, total_length_b, raw_corr_b, scaled_corr_b, patristic_c, total_length_c, raw_corr_c, scaled_corr_c, length_ratio_b_a, distance_b_over_a. Only the stated finite computational experiment is supported.
